heroHeading: Sheikh Zayed's first nursery, trusted by families since 2007.
heroSubheading: Located in the heart of Sheikh Zayed, Cute Kids Academy has cared for infants, toddlers, and preschoolers since 2007 — with afterschool care and summer and winter camps too.
missionHeading: Why parents feel at home at Cute Kids Academy
missionText: We combine parenting consultation with child development expertise to personalize a plan for every child — backed by a team of psychologists, behavioral consultants, and licensed specialists who know early childhood inside and out.

missionPoints.title: Safety First
missionPoints.text: Constant staff supervision in every classroom corner, CCTV cameras, and a layout designed to prevent accidents — peace of mind for parents, protection for every child.

missionPoints.title: Expert-Led Team
missionPoints.text: Our team includes a PhD child psychologist, a licensed speech-language pathologist, and a certified parenting coach — real specialists behind every child's care.

missionPoints.title: A Real Weekly Rhythm
missionPoints.text: English & Arabic, Math & Quran, Montessori, circle time, and outdoor play every week — plus monthly trips, fundays, and Zumba sessions.

missionPoints.title: Nutrition & Care
missionPoints.text: Three nutritious meals a day, prepared with a focus on health and balance, in a space built just for growing kids.
